PR is draft.

### ① Derived judgments

**Which released objectstack versions announce `file-storage` only.** Verified from npm tarballs in scratch, not from the shallow objectstack checkout (283 commits, oldest 2026-09-21, so `git log -S` there cannot date the mirror). `@objectstack/runtime@17.0.0` (published 2026-08-14) `dist/index.js` line 8437 emits only `"file-storage": filesRegistered ? svcAvailable(routes.storage, ...)`; no `storage:` services row (grep count 0). `@objectstack/metadata-protocol@17.0.0` has only `"file-storage": { route: "/api/v1/storage" }` and no `services["file-storage"] = ...` mirror. From 17.1.0 (2026-08-20) both producers announce both: runtime lines 8909–8910 build `storage` and `"file-storage"` from the identical `svcAvailable(routes.storage, void 0, filesSvc)` expression; metadata-protocol line 3626 is `services["file-storage"] = { ...services["storage"] }`. So the pre-mirror set is exactly `17.0.0` GA plus the seven `17.0.0-rc.x` prereleases; every 17.1.0–17.4.0 release carries the mirror. Spec: `CoreServiceName` options extracted from each published `dist/system/index.js`: 17.0.0 has 15 members without `storage`; 17.1.0–17.4.0 have 16 with both `storage` and `file-storage`. CHANGELOG entry `593c4bf` verified in the 17.4.0 tarball at line 14515, under the `## 17.1.0` heading (line 12614), text as the dev quoted; it also states the alias "retires through the standard retirement flow at the next major", so the framework mirror does not depend on objectui reading it.

**Does the console still support 17.0.0 backends.** No documented server-version floor exists: `git grep -i compatib` over `apps/console/README.md`, `packages/*/README.md`, `docs` finds nothing on backend versions; the console gates on no discovery version. The only documented posture is AGENTS.md's dependency-major rule ("major 相同即兼容"). Declared ranges on main: console `@objectstack/spec ^17.0.0` (dev), `@objectstack/client ^17.3.0`; published deps it bundles already sit higher (`@object-ui/types ^17.4.0`, `app-shell ^17.3.0`, `core ^17.3.0`, `data-objectstack` client `^17.3.0`); lock resolves `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`. Flag, not a stopper: after this PR the console's own `^17.0.0` range is behaviourally false (its test now asserts `SLOTS.has('storage')`, false at 17.0.0), and `check:spec-floors` (`scripts/check-spec-range-floors.mjs`) cannot see it because it judges spec-symbol references in published artifacts only, so the dev's "not reached" is accurate. The PR does not raise the floor.

**Stop condition versus the no-staged-window posture.** Read literally, the stop condition fires: a released GA server (`runtime@17.0.0`) announces `file-storage` without `storage`. The dev proceeded on a narrowed reading ("a server built on the installed 17.4.0") and declared it. Against that: the card's ordered deliverable is itself "delete `DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES` and the special-cased lookup", which is the fallback; under the wide reading the card could never be done while 17.0.0 exists on npm, contradicting the maintainer's 「5291 放回队列」. The 2026-08-27 ruling is real and standing: objectstack `.changeset/15932-...md:71`, `19116-...md:23`, `19580-...md:137` each carry "No deprecation window (maintainer 2026-08-27: 「项目在创业阶段,用户也很少,短期不考虑渐进」)", and objectstack `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:253` codifies "废弃别名/拼写与能力退役默认立即退休,无分阶段". Dropping a 6-day-old, four-minors-superseded 17.0.0 is consistent with that. What is wrong: triage `5805869684`'s premise "无用户可见变化,纯清理" is false for 17.0.0 hosts (the changeset correctly says so), and the implementer, not the seat, resolved the reading. The seat must record acceptance of the 17.0.0 drop; no code change follows from it.

**`routes.storage` fallback.** Correct. `ApiRoutesSchema` (`src/api/discovery.zod.ts`) has `storage: z.string().optional()` in both 17.0.0 (line 176) and 17.4.0 (line 280); it never had `file-storage`. `metadata-protocol@17.0.0` line 3270 maps service `"file-storage"` to route key `"storage"`. Head code: `serviceInfo?.route ?? discoveredRoutes[serviceName] ?? catalog.defaultRoute` with `serviceName = 'storage'`. Practically inert: both producers always set `route` on a usable row, and an unregistered row is `svcUnavailable` and never reaches the prefix.

**Tests, read not run.** Head file: 11 `it(` lines, one `it.each` over 4 entries, so 14 cases, matching the claimed 14. Red on base by reading: (1) tripwire `SERVICE_ENDPOINT_CATALOG.storage toBeDefined` is undefined on base (keyed `'file-storage'`); (2) `does not read the deprecated file-storage alias` gives `{'file-storage': USABLE}`, base resolves `discoveredServices['storage'] ?? discoveredServices['file-storage']` to USABLE and renders, so `toBeUndefined` fails; (3) `falls back to routes.storage` gives a usable row without `route` and `routes: {storage: '/api/v2/files'}`, base indexes `discoveredRoutes['file-storage']` and lands on `/api/v1/storage`. Exactly 3, as claimed. Mirror-shape control is a real producer shape: `svcAvailable` returns `{enabled: true, status, handlerReady, route, provider}` (objectstack `http-dispatcher.ts` line 1672–1681), which is the test's `USABLE_STORAGE` field set, and both producers emit byte-equal rows from 17.1.0. The every-key-is-a-slot tripwire holds: head catalog keys `ai, realtime, notification, analytics, automation, ui, storage` are all in the 17.4.0 enum.

**Other readers.** `git grep -n -E "file-storage|fileStorage|file_storage|DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES" refs/review/pr-10498 -- apps packages` excluding CHANGELOG: 8 hits, all in the two touched files (6 test, 2 source comments), none a reader; `DEPRECATED_SERVICE_SLOT_ALIASES` 0 hits at head. Whole tree adds only the changeset.

### ② Semver level

`@object-ui/console` is released: in `.changeset/config.json` `fixed` group, absent from `ignore`, `publishConfig.access: public`, version 17.6.0, no `private`; `check-changeset-presence.mjs` header calls it "the single most-edited published package". So a bump level is legitimate and an empty frontmatter would have been wrong given a behaviour change. `patch` is defensible: the removed export is not on the package's `exports` map (only `./plugin.js`), and no documented server floor is broken. AGENTS.md line 271 says objectui breaking changes take `minor`; the only mechanical gate ("Changeset Bump Policy" runs `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`) does not adjudicate patch-versus-minor. Judgment call, patch acceptable; minor would be the conservative choice.

Changeset prose, sentence by sentence: keyed by `storage` and reads only that slot, true (head `discoveredServices[serviceName]`); direct lookup and fail-closed per ADR-0076 D12, true (code comment and `usable = serviceInfo ? isServiceUsable(serviceInfo) : false`); #5286 kept `file-storage` with an alias table reading `storage` first, true (base diff); spec now lists `storage`, true (17.1.0 onward, lock at 17.4.0); mirror-carrying releases render the same group, true for 17.1.0–17.4.0; older backend hides the group, true (17.0.0 verified); `routes.storage` now supplies the prefix and `file-storage` never matched the route key, true (`ApiRoutesSchema`). No cross-file `path:line` citations in the changeset, source, tests, or commit messages.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Stop condition, declared deviation.** Literal text fires on `runtime@17.0.0`; dev proceeded on a narrowed reading. Substance consistent with the 2026-08-27 ruling and the card's deliverable; the seat, not the dev, must record the acceptance. Triage's "no user-visible change" premise is false for 17.0.0 hosts.
- **Patch changeset rather than empty.** Correct direction; see ②.
- **Acceptance-note carrier as a role.** os-dev.md line 50: `carrier:` is the PR or person who will touch the file, else 「承接者:无」. "whoever retires the alias at the next major" is neither. Also the report's `out_of_scope_findings` is `[]` while the PR names a carrier; the contract puts a carried finding in that array. Form only; the dev's offered fix ("carrier none") is right.
- **Comment drift at objectstack mirror sites.** Confirmed at objectstack `origin/main` `aa04ea2`: `http-dispatcher.ts` lines 2063–2068 and `protocol.ts` lines 6201–6208 name "objectui's console endpoint catalog" as the reader of the `file-storage` key; false once this lands. Not class a/b/c under os-dev.md lines 41–45, so "noted, not filed" is per contract; harmless because `593c4bf` ties the alias lifetime to the next major, not to this reader.
- **Floor honesty.** Console's `@objectstack/spec ^17.0.0` is now false for its own test suite and for the page's wire behaviour; effective floor is 17.4.0 via `@object-ui/types`. Not gated, not raised. Follow-up material, not a stopper.
- **Clause-②: no is correct.** objectstack `execution-duties.md:66` criterion is "放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗"; this narrows the accept set and touches no published contract surface.
- **Commit trailers** use the role-file pair (`Claude-Session` plus `Co-authored-by: Claude`), declared; repo rule takes precedence over the harness reminder.
- **CI state**, read only, second read at 2026-09-25T05:27:37Z: 42 check-runs, 36 success, 3 skipped (dependabot, coverage, coverage shard — expected), 3 still in_progress: `Test (shard 4/8)`, `Lint`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`. Type Check and shards 1–3, 5–8 concluded success. Nothing has failed. Not landable until the three conclude.
- **Nothing found in the code that should stop landing.** Discovery lookup, route resolution, tripwire, and the fail-closed control are correct against spec 17.4.0 and both producers at 17.1.0 and later.
